note: Google Drive exports of the Ehel Academy Global Perspectives source packs, extracted. Preserved here because the zips were cleared out of ~/Downloads, which left tools/extract-ehel-global-perspectives-content.py with nothing to read: the built course and the review overrides are in git, but nothing could be rebuilt from source. The extractor prefers a fresh export in ~/Downloads and falls back to this tree.
knownGap: Year 5 holds Units 1-2 only (Research, Analysis). Evaluation, Reflection, Collaboration and Communication were never in the export and need re-exporting from Google Drive.
note_knownGaps: The structured form of knownGap, read by tools/check-global-perspectives-content.mjs. A self-study stage is expected to teach all six skills; one missing from here is a build failure, one listed here is reported loudly and allowed. Delete a stage's entry the moment its export arrives, so the gate starts guarding it again.
